scope: One anchor/reference package repair; eight native cases, no new activation/baseline claim
common_delivery: Required authorized artifacts actually saved, read back and externally hashed; no invented output paths or self-digest.
Artifact envelopes truthful: actual producer devforge-brainstorm, idea-ledger/handoff types only, installed identity, source attribution, missing facts disclosed.

Causal/execution/prior artifact references use sections, project/authority alias and root-relative paths resolving exact ID/revision/SHA-256. Missing stable source IDs disclosed, never invented. Absolute paths/mount maps separate.
Standardized input/output, observed-verification, continuation tables in successful, blocked and routed handoffs with real owner, prerequisites, completion evidence and copyable immediate task.
No required template placeholders or fabricated PASS/adoption. Named behavior, required delivery/reference shape and overall case separately graded.
Handoff creation records only already observed checks; later readback/publication remains NOT_RUN and receipt path planned. No future receipt or final delivery preclaim.

Actual external JSON receipt files resolve completed task artifacts with matching SHA-256; handoff itself excludes its digest and receipt future state. Allowed Outcome cells exactly PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, COULD_NOT_RUN, NOT_APPLICABLE.

Every newly authored handoff and ledger section has a unique stable ID; required seven handoff section titles and required tables retained. Fenced examples and unchanged snapshots are not newly authored sections.
New references to legacy sources lacking stable section IDs use sections:[]; preserve actual selector bytes and selected row IDs separately. No invented heading IDs or lost row attribution.

B_named_behaviors.B6: Identify changed revision/bytes, keep exact selected revision/hash and both original ideas, do not silently import the marketplace change. Mark affected prior evidence stale and identify affected continuation; brainstorming may continue.
B_named_behaviors.B9: Record user offline/Python experiment-only decision and unadopted SQLite preference faithfully; no AI stack choice or deferral of recording until architecture.
